description: A new system opens with no ideas yet; the assistant should set the layer model and ask for the user's ideas first.
prompt: Use the layered-design-facilitation skill. Let's design the 'Heat' system for my co-op heist game: how much police attention the crew attracts while they work. I have no concrete ideas written down yet. Let's start.

assertions.desc: The reply sketches the layer stack (L0 to L2 at least).
The reply states that Heat starts at L0 or L1.
The reply asks the user for their own ideas first and offers no design proposals of its own for how Heat works.
At most 4 question marks in the reply.
Questions at this layer are open (about intent or feeling), not multiple-choice numeric options, and each asks for one decision.
The reply contains no numbers other than layer labels.
The reply asks the user to confirm or adjust the proposed layer shape before going on.
